name: kanzo-ui
description: Kanzo design system — a domain-free component library over Ark UI, the design tokens it is themed by, and the colour derivation behind them.

scripts.//check:generated: palette-data.json, themes.css, theme-data.json, palettes/ and tokens.css' colour half are generated. Regenerate and fail if the checked-in copies differ, so a hand-edit or a stale commit cannot ship. The theme's own `gen` builds @kanzo-tech/palette first, so one command covers both packages.
scripts.check:generated: pnpm --filter @kanzo-tech/theme gen && git diff --exit-code -- packages/palette/palette-data.json packages/theme/themes.css packages/theme/theme-data.json packages/theme/tokens.css packages/theme/palettes
scripts.//release: Scoped to packages/*: the docs app must never sit on the publish path.
